rationale: KAN-272 adds Render cold start survivability: liveness endpoints (/health, /api/v1/health, /metrics) get a 5s timeout (LIVENESS_TIMEOUT_MS) instead of the 15s general proxy timeout. Upstream 5xx and timeouts on liveness paths return 503 backend_waking (transient), while non-liveness paths also return 503 backend_waking per KAN-272 semantics. Connection failures remain 502 backend_unreachable. Tests updated to reflect new semantics.
